profileSync.title: Write your Zhihu into the story
profileSync.consentBody: With your consent we read your public Zhihu creations and favorites (titles & summaries only, top 20 creations by upvotes) and distill them with AI into an interest profile and “precedent cards” — story characters can quote your answers, and the court verdicts remember your stance. We store only the distilled result, never full answers or credentials, and you can wipe it anytime.
profileSync.reauth: Your Zhihu authorization has expired — sign in again to keep syncing.
profileSync.followeesOptIn: Also authorize my follow list (public info only, powers “shadow NPCs”)
profileSync.emptyZhihu: Sync finished — but your Zhihu has no public answers, favorites or bio yet. Try inviting “popular Zhihu travelers” as shadow guests in an ensemble scene; write a few answers on Zhihu and hit “Sync again” to light up your profile and precedent cards.
profileSync.noProfileYet: Precedent cards are in, but profile distillation didn't succeed — “Sync again” to retry.
